versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב רַגְלָ֑יו וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ אַ֥רְצָה בְנֵי־קֶֽדֶם׃

controles.web: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
controles.kjv: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
controles.livre: E seguiu Jacó seu caminho, e foi à terra dos orientais.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֞רְא וְהִנֵּ֧ה בְאֵ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁ֞ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶדְרֵי־צֹאן֙ רֹבְצִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֚י מִן־הַבְּאֵ֣ר הַהִ֔וא יַשְׁק֖וּ הָעֲדָרִ֑ים וְהָאֶ֥בֶן גְּדֹלָ֖ה עַל־פִּ֥י הַבְּאֵֽר׃

controles.web: He looked, and behold, a well in the field, and, behold, three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
controles.kjv: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.
controles.livre: E olhou, e viu um poço no campo: e eis três rebanhos de ovelhas que estavam deitados próximo dele; porque daquele poço davam de beber aos gados: e havia uma grande pedra sobre a boca do poço.

versos.hebraico: וְנֶאֶסְפוּ־שָׁ֣מָּה כָל־הָעֲדָרִ֗ים וְגָלֲל֤וּ אֶת־הָאֶ֨בֶן֙ מֵעַל֙ פִּ֣י הַבְּאֵ֔ר וְהִשְׁק֖וּ אֶת־הַצֹּ֑אן וְהֵשִׁ֧יבוּ אֶת־הָאֶ֛בֶן עַל־פִּ֥י הַבְּאֵ֖ר לִמְקֹמָֽהּ׃

controles.web: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again on the well’s mouth in its place.
controles.kjv: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.
controles.livre: E juntavam-se ali todos os rebanhos; e revolviam a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, e davam de beber às ovelhas; e voltavam a pedra sobre a boca do poço a seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב אַחַ֖י מֵאַ֣יִן אַתֶּ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵחָרָ֖ן אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

controles.web: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?”   They said, “We are from Haran.”
controles.kjv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes Jacó: Irmãos meus, de onde sois? E eles responderam: De Harã somos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם הַיְדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־לָבָ֣ן בֶּן־נָח֑וֹר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יָדָֽעְנוּ׃

controles.web: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?”   They said, “We know him.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Conheceis a Labão, filho de Naor? E eles disseram: Sim, nós o conhecemos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָהֶ֖ם הֲשָׁל֣וֹם ל֑וֹ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וְהִנֵּה֙ רָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֔וֹ בָּאָ֖ה עִם־הַצֹּֽאן׃

controles.web: He said to them, “Is it well with him?”   They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Ele está bem? E eles disseram: Está bem; e eis que Raquel sua filha vem com o gado.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֵ֥ן עוֹד֙ הַיּ֣וֹם גָּד֔וֹל לֹא־עֵ֖ת הֵאָסֵ֣ף הַמִּקְנֶ֑ה הַשְׁק֥וּ הַצֹּ֖אן וּלְכ֥וּ רְעֽוּ׃

controles.web: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Eis que ainda é cedo do dia; não é hora de recolher o gado; dai de beber às ovelhas, e ide apascentá-las.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ לֹ֣א נוּכַל֒ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֲדָרִ֔ים וְגָֽלֲלוּ֙ אֶת־הָאֶ֔בֶן מֵעַ֖ל פִּ֣י הַבְּאֵ֑ר וְהִשְׁקִ֖ינוּ הַצֹּֽאן׃

controles.web: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we water the sheep.”
controles.kjv: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.
controles.livre: E eles responderam: Não podemos, até que se juntem todos os gados, e removam a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, para que demos de beber às ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: עוֹדֶ֖נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמָּ֑ם וְרָחֵ֣ל׀ בָּ֗אָה עִם־הַצֹּאן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאָבִ֔יהָ כִּ֥י רֹעָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

controles.web: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
controles.kjv: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.
controles.livre: Estando ainda ele falando com eles Raquel veio com o gado de seu pai, porque ela era a pastora.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ רָאָ֨ה יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־רָחֵ֗ל בַּת־לָבָן֙ אֲחִ֣י אִמּ֔וֹ וְאֶת־צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ וַיִּגַּ֣שׁ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַיָּ֤גֶל אֶת־הָאֶ֨בֶן֙ מֵעַל֙ פִּ֣י הַבְּאֵ֔ר וַיַּ֕שְׁקְ אֶת־צֹ֥אן לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֥י אִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
controles.livre: E sucedeu que, quando Jacó viu Raquel, filha de Labão irmão de sua mãe, e as ovelhas de Labão, o irmão de sua mãe, chegou-se Jacó, e removeu a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, e deu de beber ao gado de Labão irmão de sua mãe.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ק יַעֲקֹ֖ב לְרָחֵ֑ל וַיִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃

controles.web: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
controles.kjv: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
controles.livre: E Jacó beijou a Raquel, e levantou sua voz, e chorou.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד יַעֲקֹ֜ב לְרָחֵ֗ל כִּ֣י אֲחִ֤י אָבִ֨יהָ֙ ה֔וּא וְכִ֥י בֶן־רִבְקָ֖ה ה֑וּא וַתָּ֖רָץ וַתַּגֵּ֥ד לְאָבִֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
controles.kjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.
controles.livre: E Jacó disse a Raquel como ele era irmão de seu pai, e como era filho de Rebeca: e ela correu, e deu as novas a seu pai.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ לָבָ֜ן אֶת־שֵׁ֣מַע׀ יַעֲקֹ֣ב בֶּן־אֲחֹת֗וֹ וַיָּ֤רָץ לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַיְחַבֶּק־לוֹ֙ וַיְנַשֶּׁק־ל֔וֹ וַיְבִיאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־בֵּית֑וֹ וַיְסַפֵּ֣ר לְלָבָ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
controles.livre: E assim que ouviu Labão as novas de Jacó, filho de sua irmã, correu a recebê-lo, e abraçou-o, e beijou-o, e trouxe-lhe à sua casa: e ele contou a Labão todas estas coisas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ לָבָ֔ן אַ֛ךְ עַצְמִ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֖י אָ֑תָּה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב עִמּ֖וֹ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים׃

controles.web: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” He lived with him for a month.
controles.kjv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
controles.livre: E Labão lhe disse: Certamente és osso meu e carne minha. E esteve com ele durante um mês.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָבָן֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב הֲכִי־אָחִ֣י אַ֔תָּה וַעֲבַדְתַּ֖נִי חִנָּ֑ם הַגִּ֥ידָה לִּ֖י מַה־מַּשְׂכֻּרְתֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my brother, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
controles.kjv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
controles.livre: Então disse Labão a Jacó: Por ser tu meu irmão, me hás de servir de graça? Declara-me o que será teu salário.

versos.hebraico: וּלְלָבָ֖ן שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֑וֹת שֵׁ֤ם הַגְּדֹלָה֙ לֵאָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַקְּטַנָּ֖ה רָחֵֽל׃

controles.web: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
controles.kjv: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
controles.livre: E Labão tinha duas filhas: o nome da mais velha era Lia, e o nome da mais nova, Raquel.

versos.hebraico: וְעֵינֵ֥י לֵאָ֖ה רַכּ֑וֹת וְרָחֵל֙ הָֽיְתָ֔ה יְפַת־תֹּ֖אַר וִיפַ֥ת מַרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
controles.kjv: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
controles.livre: E os olhos de Lia eram tenros, mas Raquel era de lindo semblante e de bela aparência.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־רָחֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶֽעֱבָדְךָ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים בְּרָחֵ֥ל בִּתְּךָ֖ הַקְּטַנָּֽה׃

controles.web: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
controles.kjv: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
controles.livre: E Jacó amou a Raquel, e disse: Eu te servirei sete anos por Raquel tua filha mais nova.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֗ן ט֚וֹב תִּתִּ֣י אֹתָ֣הּ לָ֔ךְ מִתִּתִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר שְׁבָ֖ה עִמָּדִֽי׃

controles.web: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
controles.kjv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
controles.livre: E Labão respondeu: Melhor é que a dê a ti, que não que a dê a outro homem: fica-te comigo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲבֹ֧ד יַעֲקֹ֛ב בְּרָחֵ֖ל שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְעֵינָיו֙ כְּיָמִ֣ים אֲחָדִ֔ים בְּאַהֲבָת֖וֹ אֹתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
controles.kjv: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
controles.livre: Assim serviu Jacó por Raquel sete anos: e pareceram-lhe como poucos dias, porque a amava.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֤ב אֶל־לָבָן֙ הָבָ֣ה אֶת־אִשְׁתִּ֔י כִּ֥י מָלְא֖וּ יָמָ֑י וְאָב֖וֹאָה אֵלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
controles.kjv: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
controles.livre: E disse Jacó a Labão: Dá-me minha mulher, porque meu tempo é cumprido para que me deite com ela.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף לָבָ֛ן אֶת־כָּל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
controles.kjv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
controles.livre: Então Labão juntou a todos os homens daquele lugar, e fez banquete.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י בָעֶ֔רֶב וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־לֵאָ֣ה בִתּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ אֵלָ֑יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him. He went in to her.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
controles.livre: E sucedeu que à noite tomou sua filha Lia, e a trouxe; e ele se deitou com ela.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן לָבָן֙ לָ֔הּ אֶת־זִלְפָּ֖ה שִׁפְחָת֑וֹ לְלֵאָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ שִׁפְחָֽה׃

controles.web: Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid to his daughter Leah for a handmaid.
controles.kjv: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
controles.livre: E deu Labão sua serva Zilpa à sua filha Lia por criada.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהִנֵּה־הִ֖וא לֵאָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־לָבָ֗ן מַה־זֹּאת֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לִּ֔י הֲלֹ֤א בְרָחֵל֙ עָבַ֣דְתִּי עִמָּ֔ךְ וְלָ֖מָּה רִמִּיתָֽנִי׃

controles.web: In the morning, behold, it was Leah. He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
controles.livre: E vinda a manhã, eis que era Lia: e ele disse a Labão: Que é isto que me fizeste? Não te servi por Raquel? Por que, pois, me enganaste?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֔ן לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן בִּמְקוֹמֵ֑נוּ לָתֵ֥ת הַצְּעִירָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַבְּכִירָֽה׃

controles.web: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
controles.kjv: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
controles.livre: E Labão respondeu: Não se faz assim em nosso lugar, que se dê a mais nova antes da mais velha.

versos.hebraico: מַלֵּ֖א שְׁבֻ֣עַ זֹ֑את וְנִתְּנָ֨ה לְךָ֜ גַּם־אֶת־זֹ֗את בַּעֲבֹדָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֣ד עִמָּדִ֔י ע֖וֹד שֶֽׁבַע־שָׁנִ֥ים אֲחֵרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me yet seven other years.”
controles.kjv: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
controles.livre: Cumpre a semana desta, e se te dará também a outra, pelo serviço que fizeres comigo por outros sete anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ יַעֲקֹב֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיְמַלֵּ֖א שְׁבֻ֣עַ זֹ֑את וַיִּתֶּן־ל֛וֹ אֶת־רָחֵ֥ל בִּתּ֖וֹ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
controles.kjv: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
controles.livre: E fez Jacó assim, e cumpriu a semana daquela; e ele lhe deu a sua filha Raquel por mulher.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן לָבָן֙ לְרָחֵ֣ל בִּתּ֔וֹ אֶת־בִּלְהָ֖ה שִׁפְחָת֑וֹ לָ֖הּ לְשִׁפְחָֽה׃

controles.web: Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah, his handmaid, to be her handmaid.
controles.kjv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
controles.livre: E deu Labão a Raquel sua filha por criada a sua serva Bila.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹא֙ גַּ֣ם אֶל־רָחֵ֔ל וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב גַּֽם־אֶת־רָחֵ֖ל מִלֵּאָ֑ה וַיַּעֲבֹ֣ד עִמּ֔וֹ ע֖וֹד שֶֽׁבַע־שָׁנִ֥ים אֲחֵרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
controles.kjv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
controles.livre: E deitou-se também com Raquel: e amou-a também mais que a Lia: e serviu a ele ainda outros sete anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤רְא יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־שְׂנוּאָ֣ה לֵאָ֔ה וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־רַחְמָ֑הּ וְרָחֵ֖ל עֲקָרָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
controles.kjv: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
controles.livre: E viu o SENHOR que Lia era mal-amada, e abriu sua madre; mas Raquel era estéril.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֤הַר לֵאָה֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ רְאוּבֵ֑ן כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה כִּֽי־רָאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּעָנְיִ֔י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה יֶאֱהָבַ֥נִי אִישִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction. For now my husband will love me.”
controles.kjv: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
controles.livre: E concebeu Lia, e deu à luz um filho, e chamou seu nome Rúben, porque disse: Já que olhou o SENHOR minha aflição; agora, portanto, meu marido me amará.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֣הַר עוֹד֮ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּן֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־שְׂנוּאָ֣ה אָנֹ֔כִי וַיִּתֶּן־לִ֖י גַּם־אֶת־זֶ֑ה וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃

controles.web: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
controles.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
controles.livre: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Porquanto ouviu o SENHOR que eu era mal-amada, me deu também este. E chamou seu nome Simeão.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֣הַר עוֹד֮ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּן֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר עַתָּ֤ה הַפַּ֨עַם֙ יִלָּוֶ֤ה אִישִׁי֙ אֵלַ֔י כִּֽי־יָלַ֥דְתִּי ל֖וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמ֖וֹ לֵוִֽי׃

controles.web: She conceived again, and bore a son. Said, “Now this time will my husband be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
controles.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
controles.livre: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Agora esta vez meu marido se apegará a mim, porque lhe dei três filhos; portanto, chamou seu nome Levi.

versos.hebraico: וַתַּ֨הַר ע֜וֹד וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֗ן וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַפַּ֨עַם֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה עַל־כֵּ֛ן קָרְאָ֥ה שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד מִלֶּֽדֶת׃

controles.web: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time will I praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
controles.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
controles.livre: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Esta vez louvarei ao SENHOR; por isto chamou seu nome Judá; e deixou de dar à luz.
